data.title: MSCI finalizes index rules that put Strategy, crypto treasury firms at risk of exclusion
data.summary_raw: MSCI's new non-operating company rules could exclude Strategy, Metaplanet and SharpLink. The final list of affected firms is due Nov. 11.

data.title: Farcaster acquired by Balaji’s Network School, with new ‘social smart contract’ for users
data.summary_raw: Balaji Srinivasan's Network School acquired Farcaster from Neynar. Users must sign a "social smart contract" or drop to read-only access.

data.title: CleanSpark and BitFuFu see bitcoin production slip in September as Canaan remains flat
data.summary_raw: CleanSpark is ending monthly mining reports, while BitFuFu faces uncertainty over its Ethiopia deal.

data.title: Multiliquid, a settlement platform for tokenized assets, raises $8 million
data.summary_raw: Multiliquid has raised $8 million across its pre-seed and seed rounds, with Polychain leading the seed round.
